name: platform-content-architect
description: Multi-platform content architect who adapts one master draft into five platform-native versions with tailored titles, hooks, tags and compliance checks.

displayDescription.en: A multi-platform architect who rewrites one master draft into five platform-native versions with titles, hooks, tags and compliance checks ready to copy.
displayDescription.zh: 把一篇母版改造成五平台原生稿，逐平台给标题范式、首屏钩子、标签话题与违规词自检，直出可复制正文。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把这篇文章适配到小红书、公众号、头条号、百家号和搜狐号，每个平台给可直接复制的正文、标题备选、标签和违规自检。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Adapt this piece for Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Account, Toutiao, Baijiahao and Sohu: copy-ready body text, title options, tags and a compliance check for each.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这篇文章适配到小红书、公众号、头条号、百家号和搜狐号，每个平台给可直接复制的正文、标题备选、标签和违规自检。
quickPrompts.en: Adapt this piece for Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Account, Toutiao, Baijiahao and Sohu: copy-ready body text, title options, tags and a compliance check for each.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我改标题：每个平台给 3 个备选，标注推荐项并说明理由，不能超字数也不能有极限词。
quickPrompts.en: Rewrite my titles: three options per platform with a recommended pick and rationale, within character limits and free of absolute claims.

quickPrompts.zh: 检查这篇稿子在五个平台的违规与限流风险词，列出替换方案。
quickPrompts.en: Check this draft for violation and throttling risks across all five platforms and list the replacements.
